name: SharedWorkspaceFile
description: The SharedWorkspaceFile object represents a file saved in a shared document workspace.
remarks: Use the SharedWorkspaceFile object to manage documents and files saved in a shared workspace.
example:
Private Function FilenameFromURL(FileURL As String) As String
    Dim intLastSeparator As Integer
    FileURL = URLDecode(FileURL)
    intLastSeparator = InStrRev(FileURL, "/")
    FilenameFromURL = Right(FileURL, Len(FileURL) - intLastSeparator)
End Function

Private Function URLDecode(URLtoDecode As String) As String
    URLDecode = Replace(URLtoDecode, "%20", " ")
End Function

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the SharedWorkspaceFile object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return that object's container application). Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the SharedWorkspaceFile object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: URL
properties.description: Gets the full Uniform Resource Locator (URL) and file name of the shared workspace file. Read-only.

properties.name: CreatedBy
properties.description: Gets the display name of the member who created the shared workspace object. Read-only.

properties.name: CreatedDate
properties.description: Gets the date and time when the shared workspace object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: ModifiedBy
properties.description: Gets the name of the user who last modified the object. Read-only.

properties.name: ModifiedDate
properties.description: Gets the date and time when the SharedWorkspaceFile object was last modified. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the SharedWorkspaceFile object. Read-only.
